page.overview:
What is Triblade?

A Triblade is a blade with three cutting edges that made its appearance as one of Jade's weapons, dubbed Cyclone Thrower, in the Mortal Kombat series. A more modern and Earthrealm-styled version of the triblade is used by Jarek in Mortal Kombat 4/Gold.

The blade made its debut in Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3 as one of Jade's weapons that was utilized in her special moves. Additionally, her Hara-Kiri from Mortal Kombat: Deception and Mortal Kombat: Unchained involved her decapitating herself with said weapon. The weapon also appears in Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks, Mortal Kombat: Armageddon, Mortal Kombat (2011), and in Mortal Kombat X, where it is used by Kitana in honor of Jade's memory.
